test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ENGINE' is written as ‘ENIGNE’ and 'TRAIN’ is written as 'NIART'. How will 'LEVEL' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'ENGINE' is written as ‘ENIGNE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae2a01b1492f6f54363f4ec8728c59693dc10dcabd22a511c3ebbe810bb0ba85.png] ​

And,

'TRAIN’ is written as 'NIART

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9d04caf4686b226ce9d62ed1fbba0c49918eb19ff03f913bc734e70119b68cd.png] 

Similarly,

'LEVEL' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1786ddd7765005e94e54bdc5294bf9463bbf37581c7ed46314c5a6ee8204f5b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"LEVEL".**
